papers.title: Prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody levels and associated factors among women admitted for delivery at Kawempe National Referral Hospital, Uganda: A cross-sectional study

findings.sentence: For the prevalence of protective anti-HBs levels, Kish's formula [22], n = Z²p(1 -p)/d², with an assumed non-protective prevalence of 22.9% as used in a previous Ugandan study [20], Z = 1.96 and a precision (d) of 5%, gave a minimum of 272 participants. For the analysis of associated factors, a sample size for comparing two proportions computed in G*Power (two-sided α 0.05, 80% power, expected proportions 0.192 and 0.052) gave 383 participants. The larger requirement was adopted, and the enrolment target was set at 420 to allow for incomplete questionnaires or unusable samples.

papers.title: How Does Psilocybin Affect Daily Life Experience and Behavior? Protocol For a Multimethod Ambulatory Assessment Study Within a Clinical Trial of Psilocybin for Depression
